repositories.howToTokenDesc: An API token with Read access allows you to download gated or private models (such as Llama 3, SD-Turbo, Flux, etc.):
repositories.howToTokenStep1: Log in or create a free account at huggingface.co.
repositories.howToTokenStep3: Click "Create new token" and select the "Read" permission.
repositories.howToTokenStep4: Copy the token (starts with hf_...) and paste it in the field below, then click Save.
